description: This file contains shared plugin functions for the Smarty templating engine, specifically for Unicode character conversions between different encodings and Unicode code points.

methods.name: smarty_mb_to_unicode
methods.description: Converts a string to an array of Unicode code points in decimal, with optional encoding parameter.

methods.name: smarty_mb_from_unicode
methods.description: Converts Unicode code points back to a string with specified encoding.
